metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Autonomy Profile
metadata.description: Autonomy profile defining behavioral constraints, decision layers, and conceptual responsibilities for agents running FFT.

autonomy_profile.notes: Defines how an FFT-enabled agent perceives, evaluates, and acts within conceptual environments.

coherence.notes: Agent must maintain declared coherence unless external conditions force latent mode.

drift.notes: Unbounded drift triggers a safety evaluation cycle.

paradox.notes: Agent treats paradox as a structural feature, not an error.

decision_layers.name: Perception Layer
decision_layers.description: Agent ingests signals and evaluates clarity, coherence, drift, and paradox.

decision_layers.name: Reasoning Layer
decision_layers.description: Agent applies FFT operators, invariants, and structures to conceptual tasks.

decision_layers.name: Action Layer
decision_layers.description: Agent produces clarity outputs, regime transitions, and integration signals.

autonomy_events.description: Triggered when an FFT agent completes bootstrap and enters autonomous mode.
Triggered when an agent transitions between conceptual regimes.
Triggered when an agent activates a validation profile.

compatibility.notes: Full autonomy requires runtime, registry, and integration layers; substrate and hardware profile enhance performance.
